desc: Specific tasks demand specific tools and that's why we brought you the Birchwood Casey® Weekender™. Featuring 27 professional gunsmith selected tools, the Weekender™ has everything the at-home gunsmith needs to perform a multitude of tasks and projects on their beloved firearms. From the basics of mounting a scope to the complexities of model specific firearm maintenance, the Weekender™ is invaluable for completing your gunsmithing tasks.
